chapter: Tiny Bradshaw, Teddy Hill and Europe
title: Stock at the Apollo with Ralph Cooper's band
summary: He briefly played in Ralph Cooper's Apollo pit band but quit after weeks since next week's show needed rehearsal, then went to the Savoy for Teddy Hill.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Then I think after that I came back and I think that was during the time I played stock in the Apollo, you know.
No, no. Ralph Cooper's band. I never played with the Savoy Sultans. This was Ralph Cooper's
band. But like I say, that was too --

Yes, the pit band, and then the pit band would play the second half of the show, they'd go up on the stage, you know, and present the band, and the band would play. But that was too hard, because while you were playing this show you had to rehearse next week's show, you know. So I soon quit that. I think I did that for about two or three weeks and I quit that because I couldn't make it. Then lo and behold, I went to work up at the Savoy for Teddy Hill.
